description: This file defines the ClaimDao class, which manages data access for claim-related entities such as ClaimEvent, ClaimExpense, ClaimRequest, ClaimAttachment, and ExpenseType. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing these entities with filtering, pagination, and auxiliary functionalities.

classes.name: ClaimDao
classes.description: Data access object class for handling CRUD operations, filtering, and pagination of claim-related entities within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Persists a ClaimEvent entity to the database.

methods.name: getClaimEventList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimEvent entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getClaimEventById
methods.description: Fetches a ClaimEvent entity by its ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingClaimEventIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing ClaimEvent entities matching provided IDs.

methods.name: deleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Marks specified ClaimEvent entities as deleted.

methods.name: getClaimEventCount
methods.description: Counts the number of ClaimEvent entities matching filter parameters.

methods.name: saveExpenseType
methods.description: Persists an ExpenseType entity.

methods.name: saveClaimRequest
methods.description: Persists a ClaimRequest entity.

methods.name: getNextId
methods.description: Calculates the next available ClaimRequest ID.

methods.name: getExpenseTypeList

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTypeCount

methods.name: getExpenseTypeById

methods.name: getExistingExpenseTypeIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing ExpenseType entities matching provided IDs.

methods.name: saveClaimExpense
